confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to successful unauthorized access, privilege escalation, bulk data exfiltration, and anti-forensic activity (log deletion) by user_04. Additionally, user_07 exhibits a pattern of suspicious cross-departmental data access.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: Multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (185.220.101.45) against user_04.
Successful unauthorized login by user_04 from the suspicious IP.
Privilege escalation: user_04 successfully elevated their role permissions.
Data exfiltration: Bulk download of multiple sensitive finance files following privilege escalation.
Anti-forensics: Deletion of authentication logs (/var/log/auth.log) to hide traces of the intrusion.

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_04's credentials were stolen via phishing or if the account was compromised via a vulnerability.
Verification of whether user_07's cross-departmental access was part of a separate insider threat or a secondary compromise.
narrative: An attacker successfully performed a brute-force attack on user_04 from an external IP, followed by privilege escalation and the bulk download of sensitive finance documents. The attacker then attempted to cover their tracks by deleting authentication logs. Concurrently, user_07 engaged in suspicious cross-departmental file downloads, suggesting either a secondary incident or an insider threat.
